lines.en: Good morning, Omar! You look tired today.
Good morning, Sara. Yes, I went to bed very late.
What time do you usually wake up?
I wake up at seven o'clock, but today I woke up at eight.
That's late! Do you eat breakfast at home?
Usually yes, we eat breakfast together, but today I had no time.
I see. How do you go to work?
I go to work by bus. The bus comes at eight thirty.
I take the metro. It is faster for me.
Lucky you! I start work at nine, and the bus is slow.
What do you do in the morning at work?
First I check my emails, then I drink coffee.
Nice. Do you take a shower in the morning?
Yes, I take a shower before work every day.
Me too. And when do you have lunch?
We have lunch at one o'clock in the office.
Do you cook your lunch at home?
No, I buy it near the office. Do you cook?
Yes, I love cooking new recipes on Friday.
That's a nice hobby! I play football with my friends on Friday.
Great! What time do you come home?
I come home at six, then I rest a little.
What do you do in the evening?
We cook dinner in the evening and watch movies.
We watch movies on Friday too! It's our family habit.
That's lovely. Do you go to bed early?
Yes, I go to bed at eleven. And you?
Usually at twelve, but I should sleep earlier.
Sleep is important! A good routine helps a lot.
You are right. I will try your routine.
Try it for one week and tell me.
Okay, I will. Thank you for the advice, Sara.
You are welcome, Omar. See you tomorrow at work!
See you! Have a nice evening.
You too. Don't forget to sleep early tonight!
I won't! Good night, Sara.
